2438-2595-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.

When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.

Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}

Repeat.

1251-3259-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

670-1619-2665-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

When the Frog enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Frog.
Repeat from step 2.

3875-5702-6871.easyPrerequisites:

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a copy of the land it is attached to.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Lithatog ability.

You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.

The Kodama of the East Tree token and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.

Both Kodama of the East Trees and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
